name: caido-wordsmith
description: Security testing wordlist generator for Caido

scripts.build: pnpm --filter caido-wordsmith-backend build && pnpm --filter caido-wordsmith-frontend build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter caido-wordsmith-backend build --watch & pnpm --filter caido-wordsmith-frontend build --watch
scripts.package: pnpm build && cp manifest.json dist/ && cd dist && zip -r ../plugin_package.zip . && echo 'Created plugin_package.zip'
